milestones.description: Plan: 'pair Cephalid Illusionist with a free-untap targeting outlet' — the Illusionist on the battlefield by turn 3.
Plan: 'pair Cephalid Illusionist with a free-untap targeting outlet (Nomads en-Kor or a Shuko ...)' — 2+ of the pair visible in hand/board.
Plan: 'The dumped Narcomoebas hit the battlefield' — mill has started once a Narcomoeba is visible on board or in the yard.
Plan: 'flash back Dread Return ... or resolve Thassa's Oracle with an empty library to win' — a payoff ever cast.
Plan: 'Set up and protect with Brainstorm, Ponder, Force of Will ...; Orim's Chant / Cabal Therapy buy a clean turn' — protection castable while the Illusionist is on board.
Plan: 'Set up ... with Brainstorm, Ponder' — rate a cantrip is cast when offered.

notes: The mill loop itself is stack-heavy activations; only its observable checkpoints (pair assembled, Narcomoeba visible, payoff cast) are text-extractable.
